notes.title: Small patch for 0.5.3
notes.content:
Fixed incorrect leaderboard view (it cropped the bottom of long leaderboards)
 Final boss spawns less enemies, but swaps attacks faster
 BUFFED level 1 and 2 for lightning, shooters, and turrets.
 BUFFED overall lightning damage
 The orbs in the "Spinning Orbs" upgrade are now made barely visible, as the visuals made flying the ship more difficult
 INTEREST is now capped at 100 extra coins per level (which you earn when having a minimum of 500 coins)

notes.title: Version 0.4.1: Quick Update Notes for 05/07/2024
notes.content:
Thanks so much for playing my game!

After some useful feedback, I've added some small Quality of Life changes:


 All of your options now save, including fullscreen, accessibility settings etc
 There's a "show tutorial" toggle in the options menu now
 You automatically pick up all coins at the end of a level
 Important: Items are all now part of a limited pool of size 6. This means it'll be harder to find the components to build a 3* upgrade (it was a little too easy before), but you'll also no longer roll upgrades which you already have 3* for.

I appreciate all of your support and feedback a lot. Let me know on Twitter (@funpuppyvideos) or in the Discussion tab. Thank you 🩷
